# Flash

**Light › Flash** · v1.0.0 · 16 frames at 30 fps (6–40)

A burst of overexposed light blows out the old scene and settles on the new one.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/flash@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/flash@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Beat drops and impacts
- Camera-flash moments
- Flashbacks

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import flash from './transitions/09-light/flash/flash';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(flash, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 16 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FFFFFF"` |  | Flash colour. |
| `bloom` | number | `2.5` | 1–6 | How much the scenes overexpose around the flash. |
